pages.text: Nothing in the homestead tier is locked. Andesite alloy, water wheels, presses, mixers, saws, millstones, belts, funnels and chutes are yours from day one.$(br2)What you cannot make yet is $(bold)brass$(), and everything brass unlocks. The dead took it. See $(l:patchouli:tech/how_blueprints_work)Blueprints & Recovery$().
Andesite alloy is the first material. Andesite is everywhere; iron nuggets come from iron clusters (see Ore).
Free power from flowing water. Large wheels give more.
Millstone grinds flour and crushes clusters; the press makes sheets.
Mixer over a basin: dough, alloy, one day brass. Fans blow and smelt.
Wrench: rotate and pick up machines. Goggles: see stress and speed.

Create explains itself: hold $(bold)W$() over any Create item for a ponder scene. This almanac only says which doors are closed.$(br2)$(bold)Closed for now:$() brass and everything on it (mechanical crafters, arms, deployers, trains), blaze burners, cannons, diesel, precision mechanisms.
